caption:
You didn't lose that money three weeks ago. You're still losing it — the trade is still open, and the number moves every day.

Closing it would make the loss real. Holding it just makes it quiet. The cost was never the position itself — it's the capital that's been frozen since the day you should have cut it, and every setup it couldn't take since.

Most people wait for it to come back instead. No new strategy fixes a position you won't close. Only closing it does.

Comment "PROFILE" and I'll send you the test on how your wiring handles a loss you haven't closed.
